articleTitle: Why Your Estradiol Gel Sits on Your Skin for Hours
imageHeadline: Estradiol Gel Still Sitting on Your Skin After an Hour?
imageSubtext: See what slows absorption and the fixes to try
pinTitle: why estradiol gel won't absorb into skin and what helps absorption
pinDescription: If your estradiol gel leaves residue hours later or feels tacky the next morning, several factors affect how it absorbs—from application site to skin prep. Get the full list of what slows absorption and the practical adjustments that help.
